description: Close Global Money Retirement by first reducing exact money/numeric wealth to compatibility-only dependencies, then atomically removing both legacy numeric economic fields from PlayerState/Snapshot with a single strict schema bump from 3.15.0 to 3.16.0. Markdown PRD is product truth; execution requires separate Human approval.
